title: How AI-friendly is Unreal Engine 5.8 compared to Godot when using Claude?
author: Faisal_alwaal
selftext:
Hey guys,

I'm curious about how well Unreal Engine 5.8 works with AI, specifically Claude. Are there any major limitations to what Claude can do within the engine?

I'm currently developing my game in Godot, mainly because Claude can handle pretty much everything on its own, from writing code and implementing features to debugging and managing the project.

I've been considering switching to Unreal Engine, but I'm wondering if Claude would have the same level of control and autonomy as it does with Godot.

For those using Claude or other AI coding agents with Unreal Engine, how has your experience been? Can AI handle most of the development process, including Blueprints, animations, and gameplay systems, or does it still require a lot of manual work in the editor?
